name: release-check
description: Release gate over a file list: audit every target, write per-file evidence, then branch to a pass/fail report. Composes flow.foreach + flow.compare + flow.branch + workflow.run across three template layers, with a hard gate (zero failures) and a soft gate (tolerated failures) — builtin-only, no external dependency

inputs.name: targets
inputs.description: List of {path, ...} entries to audit, one per file

inputs.name: max_failures
inputs.description: Failures tolerated by the SOFT gate; the hard gate still requires zero

inputs.name: report_path
inputs.description: Where the final PASS/FAIL report is written

outputs.name: passed
outputs.description: True when the hard gate (zero failures) is satisfied

params.message: soft check: ${nodes.scan_all.outputs.failed_count} file(s) failed, more than the ${inputs.max_failures} tolerated (continuing)
release gate failed: ${nodes.scan_all.outputs.failed_count} file(s) did not pass; per-file details in ${nodes.scan_all.outputs.results_file}
